outcome.label: middling
outcome.summary: Sportsbet.io has a current, broad sportsbook/casino surface, a traceable operator and a current Curaçao licence. It remains middling in this evidence model because reviewed sources do not establish launch chronology, audited economics, liabilities or independent player activity.

why.summary: A combined sportsbook/casino, broad game library and current rewards program create cross-sell and retention surfaces, while a named entity and licence improve traceability. The absence of comparable, audited operating data prevents a stronger causal or financial conclusion.

strategic_choices.decision: Combine sports betting with more than 2,000 casino games.
strategic_choices.consequence: The operator can cross-sell distinct wagering use cases, while retaining custodial balance and counterparty risk.

strategic_choices.decision: Use conventional rewards instead of a native platform token.
strategic_choices.consequence: Free bets, spins, chips and cash rewards avoid token-market complexity but remain operator-controlled liabilities.

strategic_choices.decision: Separate some payment processing into a Cyprus subsidiary.
strategic_choices.consequence: Operational responsibilities are divided across entities, requiring reviewers to avoid confusing payment services with gambling operation.

counterfactual.summary: A sportsbook-only product would reduce lobby complexity but lose casino cross-sell; a native token might deepen loyalty but add token, liquidity and regulatory risk. Neither effect is measured.

watch.signal: Licence, operator, payment subsidiary and restricted-jurisdiction changes.
watch.implication: These determine the continuing legal-entity boundary.

watch.signal: Independent active-user, wagering and withdrawal-performance data.
watch.implication: Comparable operating evidence could raise or lower the middling label.

What are audited revenue, liabilities and reserve controls?

Which local jurisdictions permit each product?

synthesis.present_situation: Sportsbet.io remains an active custodial sportsbook/casino with current rewards and a disclosed Curaçao operator and licence.
synthesis.business_mechanism: A shared member account monetizes sports and casino wagering through house margin and provider economics.
synthesis.token_contribution: No native token was identified; operator rewards provide loyalty incentives.
synthesis.chain_dependence: Crypto networks support deposits and withdrawals, not public execution of individual wagers.
synthesis.risk_legal_posture: The operator/licence boundary is visible, while local legality, custody and liabilities require separate evidence.
synthesis.success_failure_hypotheses: Breadth and rewards support retention, but absent independent activity data caps the assessment.
synthesis.counterfactual: Single-product focus reduces complexity but cross-sell; tokenization adds utility possibilities and new risk.
lessons_learned: A broad product catalog is not a financial metric.
Payment subsidiaries must not be misidentified as gambling operators.

case.product_scope_note: This case covers the custodial casino at bitstarz.com managed by Gareton B.V. It excludes similarly named brands, does not infer a native token from supported crypto deposits, and treats historical promotional metrics as operator reports rather than audited financial statements.
case.token_utility: No native BitStarz platform token was identified; crypto and fiat are supported account funding methods.

outcome.label: successful
outcome.summary: BitStarz is an operationally successful crypto-casino incumbent: its documented history begins in April 2014, its ten-year milestone was active in 2024, and current terms identify a live operator and Curaçao licence in 2026. This does not establish audited profitability or solvency.

why.summary: Early Bitcoin positioning, later fiat/altcoin expansion and a substantially broader game library plausibly supported longevity. Evidence demonstrates continuity but does not isolate the contribution of brand, catalog, payments or promotions.

strategic_choices.decision: Launch as a Bitcoin casino in 2014 and later add fiat and additional cryptocurrencies.
strategic_choices.consequence: The product preserved crypto-native identity while broadening payment access.

strategic_choices.decision: Expand from roughly 20 launch games into a large multi-provider catalog.
strategic_choices.consequence: Catalog breadth can improve retention and discovery, while increasing dependence on third-party providers.

strategic_choices.decision: Retain conventional account rewards rather than issue a native token.
strategic_choices.consequence: The operator avoids token-market risk while all reward value remains a custodial contractual obligation.

counterfactual.summary: Remaining Bitcoin-only with a small catalog likely would have constrained addressable demand. Issuing a token might add loyalty mechanics but introduce liquidity and regulatory dependencies absent from the current model.

watch.implication: These could break the continuity assumed by the current outcome.

watch.signal: Independent player activity, liabilities, reserves and withdrawal performance.
watch.implication: Operational longevity should be tested against financial and custody quality.

Which local jurisdictions permit access?

synthesis.present_situation: BitStarz remains an active custodial casino under a disclosed Curaçao entity and licence after a documented 2014 launch.
synthesis.business_mechanism: A multi-provider casino earns house/provider margin across crypto- and fiat-funded accounts.
synthesis.token_contribution: No native token was identified; supported crypto assets are account funding methods.
synthesis.chain_dependence: Chains support payments, while balances and game outcomes are operator/provider controlled.
synthesis.risk_legal_posture: Current operator and licence are traceable; liabilities, reserves and local availability remain unknown.
synthesis.success_failure_hypotheses: Early crypto focus plus payment and catalog expansion plausibly explain longevity.
synthesis.counterfactual: Bitcoin-only and small-catalog continuity likely would narrow demand.

outlook.scope_guard: Operational longevity, not audited financial success.

lessons_learned: A decade of continuity is strong product evidence.
Crypto-fiat support is a payments strategy, not tokenization.

case.product_scope_note: This case covers the custodial casino and sportsbook at duelbits.com. The current homepage identifies Liquid Entertainment N.V.; a 2026 operator-authored article instead says Liquid Gaming N.V. and supplies an older-format licence number. The dossier preserves that conflict, excludes payment/support subsidiary Herpestidae Services Limited as operator, and limits provably-fair claims to Duelbits Originals.
case.token_utility: No native Duelbits token was identified in the reviewed current operator and product materials.

outcome.label: middling
outcome.summary: Duelbits remains an active crypto casino/sportsbook with a documented 2020 origin and reproducible fairness mechanics for its Originals. A conflict between current operator-controlled surfaces over the legal operator and licence prevents a stronger result.

why.summary: A combined sportsbook/casino and per-round verification for Originals create product breadth and a crypto-native trust mechanism. However, provable fairness does not prove solvency, and unresolved operator/licence identity is a material governance and legal weakness.

strategic_choices.decision: Combine sportsbook and casino within a custodial crypto account.
strategic_choices.consequence: Product breadth supports cross-sell while concentrating balance and payout risk with the operator.

strategic_choices.decision: Make Duelbits Originals reproducible through server seed, client seed and nonce disclosures.
strategic_choices.consequence: Players can verify individual in-house outcomes, but not custody, solvency or third-party games.

strategic_choices.decision: Use separate Curaçao and Cyprus entities for operation versus management/payment/support.
strategic_choices.consequence: Functional separation can support operations, but inconsistent operator naming impairs accountability.

counterfactual.summary: Without verifiable Originals, users would rely more heavily on operator assertions; without a custodial account, the product would require a materially different settlement model. Clear, consistent entity disclosure could raise confidence without changing gameplay.

watch.signal: Reconciliation of Liquid Entertainment N.V. versus Liquid Gaming N.V. and a current CGA certificate.
watch.implication: A consistent regulator-backed record would resolve the main publication limitation.

watch.signal: Verifier continuity and independently audited reserves/liabilities.
watch.implication: These distinguish game-result integrity from broader custody quality.

unknowns: Which legal entity and licence currently govern duelbits.com?
What are audited player liabilities and reserves?
How many unique active users generate current activity?
What percentage of wagers use verifiable Originals?

synthesis.present_situation: Duelbits remains active, but current operator-controlled surfaces conflict over its legal entity.
synthesis.business_mechanism: A custodial casino/sportsbook earns wagering margin across in-house and third-party products.
synthesis.chain_dependence: Crypto networks fund custodial balances; fairness commitments verify Originals outcomes off the public settlement path.
synthesis.risk_legal_posture: Operator/licence inconsistency and unaudited custody are the central risks.
synthesis.success_failure_hypotheses: Product breadth and verifiable Originals support continuity; identity opacity prevents a success label.
synthesis.counterfactual: Consistent entity disclosure could improve confidence without altering the product.
lessons_learned: Provable fairness is narrower than platform trust.
Conflicting first-party identity claims must remain visible.

outcome.label: successful
outcome.summary: CoinPoker has maintained a poker-led crypto product from a documented 2017 launch through current June–July 2026 legal and product surfaces, adding casino and betting while retaining CHP bonus utility. Success is operational, not audited financial performance.

why.summary: A clear poker niche, expansion into casino/betting and broad crypto funding plausibly support continuity. CHP remains secondary bonus utility rather than the sole game currency, reducing token dependence while limiting direct value capture.

strategic_choices.decision: Lead with online poker, then add casino and betting products.
strategic_choices.consequence: The platform preserves a differentiated poker identity while broadening cross-sell and provider dependence.

strategic_choices.decision: Use USDT as the principal game currency and CHP primarily for bonuses.
strategic_choices.consequence: Stablecoin wagering reduces native-token volatility in gameplay while making CHP less central to core economics.

strategic_choices.decision: Support multiple crypto payment networks within a custodial account.
strategic_choices.consequence: Funding becomes more accessible, but payment-chain transparency does not extend to poker settlement or platform liabilities.

counterfactual.summary: Remaining poker-only would preserve focus but limit cross-sell. Making CHP mandatory for all games would deepen token utility but expose players and platform economics to greater token liquidity and volatility risk.

watch.signal: Operator, Anjouan licence and restricted-territory updates.
watch.implication: These govern the legal product boundary.

watch.signal: CHP contract, supply and actual bonus utilization plus active poker liquidity.
watch.implication: These would clarify whether token and poker-network effects remain material.

unknowns: What is the canonical current CHP contract and circulating supply?
What are audited player liabilities and reserves?
How many unique active poker players and tables exist?
What share of activity comes from casino and betting rather than poker?

synthesis.present_situation: CoinPoker remains an active poker-led custodial platform with casino, betting and CHP bonus utility.
synthesis.business_mechanism: Poker rake and casino/betting margin are generated inside a multi-asset custodial account.
synthesis.token_contribution: CHP supports bonuses and benefits; USDT remains the principal game currency.
synthesis.chain_dependence: Solana, Bitcoin and Ethereum support funding, while games and account settlement remain operator controlled.
synthesis.risk_legal_posture: A current operator and Anjouan licence are disclosed; custody and local availability remain separate risks.
synthesis.success_failure_hypotheses: Poker differentiation and product expansion support longevity without making the token mandatory.
synthesis.counterfactual: Poker-only focus limits cross-sell; mandatory CHP increases token risk.
lessons_learned: A token can remain peripheral while the core product succeeds.
Crypto deposits do not make multiplayer poker onchain.

case.product_scope_note: This case covers the Purebet Solana sports-betting aggregator/exchange and the official purebet.io frontend. It does not claim that every historical Solana program has ceased, does not classify unrelated products named Purebet, and distinguishes the hibernating official product from the continued operation of the Solana chain or other betting protocols.
case.token_utility: No Purebet-native token was identified in the reviewed official product and promotion materials.

sources.notes: Current official frontend states that Purebet is hibernating.

sources.notes: Historical official evidence of Solana wallet betting and liquidity aggregation; promotion is ended.

claims.analyst_note: Supports official product pause, not destruction of every program.

claims.evidence_locator: Historical terms describe bets placed from user wallets, a Purebet liquidity-aggregation wallet, transaction-hash verification and Solana protocol comparisons.
claims.analyst_note: Establishes the historical onchain sports-betting product model.

By the review date, the official frontend identified Purebet as hibernating; the start date is unknown.

outcome.label: failed
outcome.summary: Purebet's official consumer product failed to sustain active operation: the current frontend explicitly says the Solana sports-betting exchange is hibernating. Legacy docs remain reachable, so the label is scoped to the official product rather than every historical program or code artifact.

why.summary: Purebet built a noncustodial Solana betting and liquidity-aggregation experience, but current primary evidence shows the official frontend no longer offers normal operation. Reviewed sources do not establish whether the cause was liquidity, demand, regulation, team capacity or competition.

strategic_choices.decision: Aggregate sports-betting liquidity and settle from user wallets on Solana.
strategic_choices.consequence: The model reduced conventional operator custody and exposed bets to public transaction proofs, while depending on onchain liquidity and wallet UX.

strategic_choices.decision: Use cross-protocol promotions to attract existing onchain bettors.
strategic_choices.consequence: The campaign targeted a knowledgeable niche but does not demonstrate durable organic demand.

strategic_choices.decision: Leave a hibernation notice and community channel rather than claim a permanent shutdown.
strategic_choices.consequence: The team preserves optionality for revival, but the official product is not currently serving its original use case.

counterfactual.summary: Deeper shared liquidity, a broader distribution partner or lower-friction onboarding might have improved continuity, but no reviewed evidence shows which constraint caused hibernation. A custodial model could simplify UX while abandoning the core noncustodial thesis.

watch.signal: Official frontend reopening, new market listings, program releases or dated team announcement.
watch.implication: Verified operation could change the label from failed to recovering.

watch.signal: Historical program activity and liquidity-wallet flows.
watch.implication: Residual onchain use would distinguish frontend failure from complete protocol inactivity.

unknowns: When did hibernation begin and why?
Are any historical Solana programs still used?
What were peak volume, liquidity and unique-user levels?
What entity controlled the frontend and aggregation wallet?
Is a relaunch funded or scheduled?

synthesis.present_situation: The Purebet frontend is hibernating; legacy API/SDK and promotion documents remain reachable.
synthesis.business_mechanism: Purebet aggregated sports-betting liquidity for wallet-based Solana wagers.
synthesis.chain_dependence: Solana supplied wallet settlement and transaction proofs; frontend and liquidity aggregation still depended on project operations.
synthesis.risk_legal_posture: Legal entity, licence and current program governance remain unknown.
synthesis.success_failure_hypotheses: The product reached a functioning first phase but did not sustain an active official interface; causal attribution is withheld.
synthesis.counterfactual: More liquidity or distribution might help, but the binding constraint is unknown.
lessons_learned: Onchain settlement does not remove frontend and liquidity dependence.
Hibernation is product failure without proving every contract is dead.
